text: The phenomenon where two highly divergent lineages are incorrectly grouped together in a parsimony analysis, regardless of their true evolutionary relationship, is called:
explanation: Long branch attraction is a well-known inconsistency of maximum parsimony under certain conditions, where highly divergent (long-branch) lineages are artifactually grouped together. Incomplete lineage sorting and horizontal gene transfer are both biological sources of gene tree/species tree discordance, an unrelated phenomenon caused by real evolutionary processes rather than a statistical artifact of the parsimony method itself.
